note: Bridge and measurement assumptions (SSOT §3.1, §14, §15; SSOT §29 lists bridges.json and observables.json as 'to add'). Each record quotes the SSOT; extract_sources.py verifies every quote against the sha256-pinned source, and check_consistency.py fails on a record whose quote was not verified. A bridge is an explicit assumption, never a theorem: 'lean' lists only statements about the bridge's rule or units, never a proof that the bridge holds. A null falsifier carries a reason quoted from, or located in, the SSOT; none is invented here.
